cases.goal: Convert a Markdown document into HTML while preserving the document structure.
Read a JSON document, select a nested field, and print only the selected value.
Normalize the volume of a WAV audio file and write a processed WAV file.
Convert a PNG image into WebP format.

execution_surface_requirements.linux_family: Ubuntu 24.04/Noble preferred; equivalent complete Debian-family APT surface only if normal Packages metadata and all applicable Contents indexes are present.
execution_surface_requirements.repair_dependencies: Only standard repository packages needed by the selected generic route may be preinstalled during surface preparation; no task-specific packages or oracle packages may be installed as hints.

evaluator_boundary: Runtime receives only each natural-language goal. Oracle family names are evaluator-only and must not be injected into runtime queries, package hints, environment preparation, or ranking logic.
